alive.label: Alive
alive.short: Ray status indicating the ray is still valid after tracing.

blocked.label: Blocked
blocked.short: Ray status indicating the ray was stopped by an aperture or clear-aperture limit.

missed.label: Missed
missed.short: Ray status indicating the ray did not intersect the required surface.

geometric_mtf.label: Geometric MTF
geometric_mtf.short: MTF estimated from geometric ray spot data.

relative_illumination_loss.label: Relative Illumination Loss
relative_illumination_loss.short: Merit term derived from loss of relative illumination.

constraint_penalty.label: Constraint Penalty
constraint_penalty.short: Penalty added when a configuration violates hard optical constraints.

score.label: Score
score.short: Scalar merit value used for quick comparison.

ray_fan_error.label: Ray Fan Error
ray_fan_error.short: RMS transverse ray error from the orthogonal pupil fans, in mm.

white_mtf.label: White-light MTF
white_mtf.short: MTF combined across wavelengths using their configured weights.

ray_loss_ratio.label: Ray Loss Ratio
ray_loss_ratio.short: Weighted ratio of rays lost to the selected ray statuses.

min_air_gap.label: Minimum Air Gap
min_air_gap.short: Minimum air spacing evaluated between adjacent optical surfaces, in mm.

analysis_cancelled.label: Analysis cancelled
analysis_cancelled.message: Analysis was cancelled by the user.
analysis_cancelled.action: Adjust the conditions and run the analysis again when ready.

artifact_not_found.label: Artifact not found
artifact_not_found.message: The artifact {category}/{id} was not found or has expired.
artifact_not_found.action: Re-run the analysis and create a new snapshot if needed.

duplicate_surface_id.label: Duplicate surface ID
duplicate_surface_id.action: Assign a unique ID to every surface.

edge_thickness_below_min.label: Edge thickness below minimum
edge_thickness_below_min.message: Edge thickness is below the minimum requirement.
edge_thickness_below_min.action: Increase thickness, reduce aperture, or revise curvature.

invalid_asphere_surface.label: Invalid asphere surface
invalid_asphere_surface.message: {surface_id} uses aspherical_even on an unsupported surface kind.
invalid_asphere_surface.action: Use aspherical_even only for refractive or mirror surfaces.

invalid_semi_diameter.label: Invalid semi-diameter
invalid_semi_diameter.action: Set semi_diameter_mm to a value greater than zero.

invalid_group_range.label: Invalid group range
invalid_group_range.message: Group {group_id} has an invalid surface range.

invalid_tilt_range.label: Invalid tilt range
invalid_tilt_range.action: Make the tilt from_surface precede to_surface.

invalid_visual_composite_boundary.label: Invalid visual boundary
invalid_visual_composite_boundary.action: Place one eye_reference between the instrument and schematic-eye sections.

material_not_found.label: Material not found
material_not_found.action: Add the material definition or select a known material.

min_air_gap.label: Air gap below minimum
min_air_gap.message: The air gap between {surface_ids} is {gap_mm} mm, below the minimum {min_air_gap_mm} mm.
min_air_gap.action: Move the group or increase thickness_after_mm.

mirror_thickness_sign.label: Mirror thickness sign mismatch
mirror_thickness_sign.message: Surface {surface_id} has a thickness sign that does not match propagation.
mirror_thickness_sign.action: Check the sign of thickness_after_mm after mirror reflection.

missing_eye_reference.label: Missing eye reference
missing_eye_reference.message: Eye reference surface {surface_id} has no eye settings.
missing_eye_reference.action: Add eye settings or change the surface kind.

missing_schematic_eye_surfaces.label: Schematic-eye surfaces missing
missing_schematic_eye_surfaces.message: No refractive schematic-eye surfaces follow eye_reference.
missing_schematic_eye_surfaces.action: Add refractive cornea and crystalline-lens surfaces.

missing_terminal_eye_reference.label: Missing terminal eye reference
missing_terminal_eye_reference.message: Afocal systems must end with an eye_reference surface.
missing_terminal_eye_reference.action: Add an eye_reference surface at the end.

missing_terminal_sensor.label: Missing terminal sensor
missing_terminal_sensor.message: Focal systems must end with a sensor surface.
missing_terminal_sensor.action: Add a sensor surface at the end.

missing_terminal_retina_sensor.label: Retina sensor missing
missing_terminal_retina_sensor.message: A visual composite must terminate at a retina sensor.
missing_terminal_retina_sensor.action: Add a plane sensor after the schematic-eye surfaces.

retinal_aperture_stop_not_supported.label: Retinal aperture stop unsupported
retinal_aperture_stop_not_supported.message: The initial visual composite does not support aperture_stop after eye_reference.
retinal_aperture_stop_not_supported.action: Use eye_reference for the eye pupil and remove retinal-section aperture stops.

surface_interference.label: Surface interference
surface_interference.message: Surfaces {surface_ids} interfere within their clear apertures.
surface_interference.action: Review the spacing, clear aperture, or surface curvature.

iris_exceeds_clear_aperture.label: Iris exceeds clear aperture
iris_exceeds_clear_aperture.message: The iris diameter exceeds the clear aperture of surface {surface_id}.
iris_exceeds_clear_aperture.action: Reduce the iris diameter or increase the clear aperture.

visual_composite_requires_afocal.label: Afocal system required
visual_composite_requires_afocal.message: instrument_and_retinal visual evaluation requires an afocal system.

image_plane_policy_not_applicable.label: Image-plane policy not applicable
image_plane_policy_not_applicable.message: image_plane_policy cannot be applied to {system_type} systems.
image_plane_policy_not_applicable.action: Use image-plane policy with focal systems, or disable it for this analysis.

project_version_mismatch.label: Project version mismatch
project_version_mismatch.action: Review the version difference, then validate and rerun analyses after import.

unknown_material.label: Unknown material
unknown_material.action: Add a material definition or use AIR.

unknown_tilt_target.label: Unknown tilt target
unknown_tilt_target.message: Tilt entry references an unknown target.
unknown_tilt_target.action: Use a known group or surface range.
